[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 11th September, 2002]
No. Legis.1(5)/02/-6704-09,
dated 11-9-2002.--The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:-
1. Short title, application and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance, may be called the North-West Frontier
Province Elementary, Education Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall extend to whole of
the North-West Frontier Province.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

3. Establishment of the Foundation. ---(1) As soon as may be
after the promulgation of this Ordinance, Government shall, by a notification,
establish a foundation to be known as the "Elementary Education
Foundation".
(2) The foundation shall be a
body corporate having perpetual succession and a common seal with power to

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Elementary Education Foundation Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Function of the Foundation

ORDINANCE XXX OF 2002
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE ELEMENTARY EDUCATION FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXX OF 2002
An Ordinance to
provide for establishment of an Elementary Education Foundation in the
North-West Frontier Province
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 11th September, 2002]
No. Legis.1(5)/02/-6704-09,
dated 11-9-2002.--The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:-
4. Function of the Foundation.
---(1) The main objective of the Foundation is to take all such measures as it
deems necessary for the promotion, improvement and financing of education and
development of the human resources in the North-West Frontier Province through
strengthening of elementary education in the private sector in line with the
education policy of Government.
(2) Without prejudice to the
generality of the objective mentioned in subsection (1), the other objectives
of the Foundation are to--
(a) give loans
to an individual or non-Governmental organization for establishment of
elementary education schools;
(b) to improve
literacy, with particular focus on women, through opening of new schools and
employment of teachers in deficient areas;
(c) improve
quality of education through effective and systematic teachers training
programme;
(d) promote
community participation and ownership of elementary education programmes at the
grass roots level;
(e) assist
national efforts at mainstreaming the education imparted in religious madrassas
and mosques;
(f) introduce
innovative educational programmes relating to literacy and skills oriented
discipline's for the exceptional disabled, related and disadvantaged children.

Member

Member

Member

Secretary

Members

Member
(2) 'The members of the Board,
other than ex officio members, shall hold office for two years only.
(3) 'The Managing Director, Elementary
Education Foundation (EEF) shall be the Secretary of the Board.
(4) The Board shall meet at least

(5) The Board shall evolve its

Powers and duties of the Board

ORDINANCE XXX OF 2002
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE ELEMENTARY EDUCATION FOUNDATION ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXX OF 2002
An Ordinance to
provide for establishment of an Elementary Education Foundation in the
North-West Frontier Province
[Gazette of
N.-W.F.P., Extraordinary, 11th September, 2002]
No. Legis.1(5)/02/-6704-09,
dated 11-9-2002.--The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:-
6. Powers and duties of the
Board.---(1) The administration and management of the Foundation and its
affairs shall vest in the Board., which may exercise all powers and do all acts
and things which may be exercised or done by the Foundation.
(2) Without prejudice to the
generality of the foregoing provisions, and subject to other provisions of this
Ordinance, the Board shall have the powers--
(a) to hold
control and administer the funds of the Foundation:
(b) to govern
and regulate with due regard to the advice of the finance and planning
committees to this behalf, the finances, accounts and investments of the
Foundation;
(c) to consider
the annual report of the Foundation and give directions as may be necessary;
(d) to consider
the annual and revised budgets and to advise Managing Director to
re-appropriate funds;
(e) to enter
into, carry out and cancel contracts on behalf of the Foundation;
(f) to cause
proper books of accounts to be kept for all sums of money received and expended
by the Foundation and for assets and liability of the Foundation;
(g) to invest any
money belonging to the Foundation in any of the Government securities;
(h) to receive
and manage any property transferred and grants, bequests, trusts, gifts,
donations, endowments and other contributions made to the Foundation;
(i) to
administer any funds placed at the disposal of the Foundation for specified
purposes;
(j) to create,
suspend or abolish such administrative posts as may be necessary;
(k) to appoint
consultants and employees in BPS-17 and above;
(l) to suspend,
punish and remove from service officers (other than Managing Director) and
other employees in the manner prescribed;
(m) to approve
rules and regulations of the Foundation;
(n) to regulate,
determine and administer all other matters concerning the Foundation and to
this end exercise all powers necessary to fulfil the requirements of this
Ordinance; and
(o) to delegate
any of its powers to an Officer or a committee or sub committee.

(2) The sources of the Fund

(i) Government

(ii) Government

9. Audit and accounts.---(1)
All monies received by the Foundation shall be kept in a separate bank account
specifically opened for the purpose.
(2) 'The bank account shall be
operated jointly by the Managing Director and Finance Officer of the
Foundation.
(3) The accounts of the Fund
shall be maintained in such form and in such manner as may be prescribed.
(4) 'The Managing Director of the
Foundation shall prepare annual account statement of the Fund within 30 days of
closing of the respective financial year. A copy of the annual statement, duly
approved by the Board, shall be sent to Secretary to Government, Finance
Department through the Secretary to Government, Schools and Literacy
Department.
(5) Accounts of the Fund shall be
audited in the prescribed manner.
